title: StarWorld AI - explore an AI generated universe with AI npcs
author: Diligent-Garage1773
selftext:
Welcome to StarWorld AI, a new kind of space RPG where AI drives just about every feature.

So far, it’s just on iOS, but will be excited to port if more people like it.

As far as dev work goes, I spec features in markdown, polish them to ensure the game is holistically cohesive, then turn over implementation to copilot. To make implementation easier, I set up a multi-project workspace in vscode with both client and backend repos in context; easy work from there. Happy to share more with those who are curious!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/starworld-ai/id6743031331

Thanks for taking a look!
